title: LLM Uncertainty Quantification
description: DSC 180A/B Capstone with Prof. Yian Ma: Research toolkit implementing mutual-information-based calibration and NLI-driven semantic clustering for quantifying LLM uncertainty. Evaluates expected calibration error (ECE) and epistemic vs. aleatoric uncertainty across TruthfulQA, ARC, SQuAD v2, and more.
